title: databraryr – Agent Guide
text: Requests: every call starts make_default_request() (make_default_request.R), builds httr2 request base URL (DATABRARY_BASE_URL), USER_AGENT, Accept: application/json, retry (RETRY_LIMIT), timeout (REQUEST_TIMEOUT). default attaches OAuth2 Authorization header refreshes token near expiry. Auth/token state: login_db() performs OAuth2 password grant; token bundle (access/refresh tokens, expiry, client id/secret, username) cached package-private environment (auth_state.R) can optionally persisted via keyring (login_db(store = TRUE)). token_helpers.R / auth_service.R handle refresh. Config: credentials host come environment variables read .Renviron — DATABRARY_CLIENT_ID, DATABRARY_CLIENT_SECRET, DATABRARY_LOGIN, optional DATABRARY_PASSWORD (else prompted via getPass), optional DATABRARY_BASE_URL (defaults https://api.databrary.org; point staging ). Package options managed via options package. Endpoints: public function lives R/ file parallel tests/testthat/test-*.R. Functions return tibbles/lists; downloads write disk return raw content.

DON’T edit README.md directly — edit README.Rmd re-knit. header says explicitly. Adding/changing endpoints add new endpoint R/<verb>_<noun>.R file, following existing naming (list_*, get_*, search_*, create_*, update_*, patch_*, delete_*, bulk_*). build requests via make_default_request() rather constructing httr2::request() scratch, auth, retry, user-agent, timeout stay consistent. add matching tests/testthat/test-<name>.R @export + roxygen docs (@examples) user-facing function. Real values belong developer’s .Renviron/keyring, never tracked files. Tests requiring live auth skip gracefully credentials absent. title: Interact with the Databrary.org API
text: on_error = "stop" (default): first failed row stops execution error class databraryr_bulk_error. tryCatch(..., databraryr_bulk_error = function(e) e$partial), use e$partial tibble rows far ("failed" / "pending" rows stop). on_error = "collect": every row attempted; failures stay "failed" function returns full tibble instead throwing. max_retries / retry_delay: optional per-row retries counting row failed.

title: Interact with the Databrary.org API
text: Use resume_bulk() run bulk function incomplete rows ("pending" "failed"), merge outcomes back original tibble (order preserved). Typical pattern on_error = "stop": Looping fix--resume (safe: e$partial always reflects full job, last retried subset): Pass every argument bulk function needs via ... except vector argument defines rows (file_paths, session_ids, folder_ids, file_ids, session_names, folder_names, record_ids, record_names). vector filled automatically partial$input incomplete rows; pass input_arg = "..." auto-detection wrong. Rename helpers (bulk_rename_sessions, bulk_rename_folders, bulk_rename_files) also take new_names parallel ids renamed. resume_bulk() forwards id/file vector—must pass new_names (subset match incomplete rows, order) . Creates--names helpers (bulk_create_sessions, bulk_create_folders, bulk_create_records) require unique names row’s input stays identifiable resuming. See ?resume_bulk individual bulk_* help pages details.
code: partial <- tryCatch(   bulk_upload_files(vol_id = 1, session_id = 42, file_paths = my_paths),   databraryr_bulk_error = function(e) e$partial )  # Fix data or environment, then: partial <- resume_bulk(partial, bulk_upload_files, vol_id = 1, session_id = 42) partial <- tryCatch(   bulk_upload_files(vol_id = 1, session_id = 42, file_paths = my_paths),   databraryr_bulk_error = function(e) e$partial ) while (any(partial$status %in% c("pending", "failed"))) {   # fix whatever caused the failure, then:   partial <- tryCatch(     resume_bulk(partial, bulk_upload_files, vol_id = 1, session_id = 42),     databraryr_bulk_error = function(e) e$partial   ) }
